title: AWS Organizations SCP and OU Changes

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:cloudtrail` events with `(eventName="AttachPolicy" OR eventName="DetachPolicy" OR eventName="CreateOrganizationalUnit" OR eventName="MoveAccount") requestParameters.targetId=*` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.1.34 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudtrail` traffic without `(eventName="AttachPolicy" OR eventName="DetachPolicy" OR eventName="CreateOrganizationalUnit" OR eventName="MoveAccount") requestParameters.targetId=*`. Confirm UC-4.1.34 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cloudtrail` collected via `Splunk_TA_aws`; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" (eventName="AttachPolicy" OR eventName="DetachPolicy" OR eventName="CreateOrganizationalUnit" OR eventName="MoveAccount") requestParameters.targetId=*
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.34_aws_organizations_scp_an_34"
| sort -_time
description: UC-4.1.34 — AWS Organizations SCP and OU Changes: queries AWS `aws:cloudtrail` for `AttachPolicy` (+3 related API operations) and returns actor, resource, and region context for security review and change validation.
value: On AWS, `AttachPolicy` activity for 'AWS Organizations SCP and OU Changes' is a high-signal control-plane change that should match approved change records and privileged-access monitoring. UC-4.1.34 drives high-priority security alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Ensure CloudTrail in management account logs Organizations API calls. Alert on AttachPolicy/DetachPolicy (SCP) and MoveAccount. Restrict who can modify SCPs via IAM and MFA.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_aws` with the modular input for `aws:cloudtrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.1.78.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Ensure CloudTrail in management account logs Organizations API calls. Alert on AttachPolicy/DetachPolicy (SCP) and MoveAccount. Restrict who can modify SCPs via IAM and MFA.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" (eventName="AttachPolicy" OR eventName="DetachPolicy" OR eventName="CreateOrganizationalUnit" OR eventName="MoveAccount") requestParameters.targetId=*
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.34_aws_organizations_scp_an_34"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudtrail` in `index=aws` to detect aws organizations scp and ou changes. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS CloudTrail console Event history for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_34_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Table (who, what, when), Timeline, Bar chart by event type..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_aws` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of aws organizations scp and ou changes so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
